data.claim: The question of which property the append-only event log requires of its writers—idempotency, safety, or neither—is unresolved among competing positions, with an unresolved rivalry among 18 positions retained at formal sequence 676.
data.qualification: The allowed sources (Python logging and sqlite3 documentation) do not contain published definitions of idempotency or safety in the distributed systems sense; the formal artifacts supply competing conjectures but no external adjudication is available within the bounded record.
